Dear Marta,

Thank you for contacting Fernwood Outfitters Support. I'm sorry for the concern this has caused.

When an order is placed, we authorize the full amount, and the charge settles when the order ships. For a day or two, both a pending authorization and a settled charge can appear, which can look like a double charge. Pending authorizations drop off automatically within five business days.

If, after that period, you still see two charges for this order, please reply with the order details and the exact amount and date of each charge, and our team will investigate. Real duplicate charges are refunded within five business days.

Warm regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for reaching out. You can download an invoice for any order from the Orders page in your account, so order 49001's invoice should be there for your accounting team. Receipts are also emailed to you when the order ships.

If the invoice doesn't show the itemized detail your company needs, a specialist will follow up with you about your options.

Best regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Amelia,

Thank you for reaching out, and I'm sorry you're having trouble logging in.

Our help article covers merging duplicate accounts, changing the email address on an account, and deleting an account, but it doesn't include steps for a login error like the one you're describing. A specialist will follow up with you about getting back into your account.

If you have a second account under a different email address, please reply with both email addresses so we can look into it as part of that follow-up.

Best regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Ravi,

Thanks for reaching out, and sorry about the trouble with your authenticator app after getting a new phone.

Our help article covers merging duplicate accounts, changing the email address on an account, and deleting an account. It doesn't describe how to recover access when an authenticator app is no longer available, so I can't give you specific steps for that here. A member of our support team will follow up with you about getting back into your account.

Fernwood Outfitters Support

Dear Lucía,

Thank you for reaching out, and I'm sorry your order has taken this long.

You can check the status of order 49087 on the Orders page of your account. Once the package leaves our warehouse, you'll see a carrier name and tracking number there, and the carrier's page updates within 24 hours of the first scan.

If the tracking page hasn't updated for more than three business days, the package may be delayed at a carrier hub. In that case, we can open a trace with the carrier, which usually resolves within five business days. I don't have details on the status of your specific order in this message, so a member of our support team will follow up with you to review it further.

Warm regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Owen,

Thanks for reaching out. Our order tracking information doesn't include delivery time estimates by destination or shipping speed, so I can't confirm when an order placed today would arrive in Vancouver. A support specialist can follow up with you on delivery timing for the faster option.

What I can tell you: if you order before 2 pm on a business day, the order leaves our warehouse the same day. Orders placed later, or on weekends, leave the next business day. Once your package ships, you can track it from the Orders page in your account, and the carrier's tracking page typically updates within 24 hours of the first scan.

Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Hana,

Thank you for letting us know, and I'm sorry your order arrived incorrect. I've read through our refund and return timeline information, but it doesn't cover exchanges or wrong-item shipments, so I can't give you the correct steps for this here. A Fernwood Outfitters specialist will follow up with you to sort out the women's medium fleece.

If you have your order number handy, please reply with it so the specialist can find your order quickly.

Warm regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Karim,

Thank you for reaching out, and I'm sorry for the wait. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within five business days after the return arrives at our warehouse. After that, your bank may take a further three to ten business days to show the credit on your statement.

Since the carrier delivered your return about two weeks ago, it's past the point where we would normally expect a refund to have appeared. Please reply with your order number so we can check the return with our warehouse. A specialist will follow up with you from there.

Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Beatriz,

Thanks for reaching out, and sorry to hear your Summit 2 tent pole cracked during setup.

Our product care guide covers washing, drying, re-proofing, and storage for shells, down, and sleeping bags, but it doesn't include information about tent pole damage or warranty coverage, so I can't confirm what options are available for your tent.

A specialist will follow up with you about the cracked pole and next steps. Please keep your proof of purchase from June handy, as it may help them assist you.

Best regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Felix,

Thanks for reaching out, and sorry your shell isn't keeping you dry. Waterproof coatings wear down with use. If water has stopped beading on the fabric, the coating may need to be restored. Our care guidance recommends washing the shell and then applying a spray-on re-proofing treatment, which restores the coating without affecting the warranty. Please make sure you're using a technical-fabric wash rather than regular detergent.

If the shell still soaks through after this, a Fernwood specialist will follow up with you on next steps.

Best regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Sarah,

Thank you for reaching out. Unfortunately, our help materials don't cover shipping to APO (military) addresses, so I can't confirm whether we ship to them. A specialist will follow up with you on this question.

In the meantime, you can check the Orders page of your account for order tracking details once an order ships, and our article notes that orders placed before 2 pm on a business day leave the warehouse the same day.

Thanks for your patience.

Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Sven,

Thanks for reaching out about order 49120. I'm sorry it hasn't arrived yet.

Standard shipping takes three to six business days after the order leaves our warehouse, and express takes one to two business days. Delivery estimates count from the shipping date, not the order date. Weather and peak seasons can also extend delivery times. If your package is more than five business days past its estimate, please contact us again and we will trace it with the carrier.

I'm not able to change the order status or issue a refund through this message. A member of our support team will follow up with you.

Best regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Chiara,

Thanks for reaching out. Our billing information doesn't cover discount code issues or applying codes after an order has been placed, so I'm not able to confirm whether SUMMER15 can be applied to your order. A member of our support team will follow up with you directly on this.

If you see any charge on your statement that doesn't match your order, please reply with the amount and date and we'll look into it.

Best regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support

Dear Mohammed,

Thank you for contacting Fernwood Outfitters Support. Yes, we can merge duplicate accounts so that your orders and rewards points appear in one place. To get started, please reply with the email addresses of both accounts and let us know which one you would like to keep. The merge takes one business day.

If you have any questions in the meantime, please let us know.

Best regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Grace,

Thanks for reaching out. Our article doesn't cover changing a shipping address on an order that has already been placed, so I can't confirm whether that's possible for your order. A member of our support team will follow up with you directly about your options.

In the meantime, you can check the status of your order from the Orders page of your account. Orders placed before 2 pm on a business day leave our warehouse the same day; later orders, or those placed on weekends, leave the next business day. Once your package ships, the order will show a carrier name and tracking number.

Thank you for your patience.

Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Pablo,

Thanks for reaching out. A flat, clumpy down jacket after washing is a common concern, and it may not mean the jacket is ruined. Our care guidance says down jackets should be washed on a gentle cycle with a technical-fabric wash, never regular detergent, and tumble dried on low. Adding two or three clean tennis balls to the dryer can help restore loft. If the jacket was washed with regular detergent or dried on a high setting, that may have contributed to the clumping.

Our guidance doesn't cover whether this specific jacket can be recovered, so a specialist will follow up with you on that.

Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hello Yasmin,

Thank you for reaching out. You can return unworn items with tags attached within 60 days of delivery. Start the return from the Orders page, select only the item you want to send back, and print the prepaid return label.

Regarding the label fee: for refunds, a flat 7 dollar label fee is deducted unless the item arrived damaged or we sent the wrong item. If you're exchanging the item for a different size or color, return shipping is free. A specialist will follow up if you need help confirming how this applies to your specific order.

Best regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Tom,

Thanks for reaching out. When an order is placed, we authorize the full amount, and the charge settles when the order ships. A pending authorization can remain on your card for a day or two, and it drops off automatically within five business days.

If the pending amount is still showing after five business days, please reply with the amount and date of the charge so we can investigate. A specialist will follow up with you from there.

Thank you for your patience.

Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Aiko,

Thank you for reaching out. Our refund timelines article covers when store credit appears in your account, which is usually the same day the return is checked in. However, it does not address whether store credit expires or whether a date is listed anywhere, so I'm unable to confirm that for you here.

A specialist will follow up with you about your store credit expiry question.

Best regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Ben,

Thanks for reaching out, and sorry to hear the carbide tip came off your trekking pole on the second hike.

Our care guide covers washing, re-proofing, and storing shells, down jackets, and sleeping bags, but it doesn't include information about trekking pole tips or whether this type of damage is covered. A member of our support team will follow up with you about your question.

Thanks for your patience.

Fernwood Outfitters Support
